confidence_notes: I ran three web searches. One gave the RBA rate. Two gave crowd-sourced cost-of-living figures and pintxo/drink price guides for San Sebastian, which differ between sources and are partly dated. The meal, coffee and beer anchors are adjusted upward from those figures for tourist-area pricing in 2026. No direct price data was found for cocktails or wine. I set them from the usual local relationship to beer and pintxo-bar prices (cocktail about 3.5 times beer, wine glass about 1.2 times beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any search or live listings. They assume July peak season, when San Sebastian prices are very high and volatile.
comparable_city_reasoning: San Sebastian is priced above Spain's average (about 15% above in one comparison site) and below Madrid and Barcelona on everyday costs, but its peak-summer accommodation is among the most expensive in Spain. I used a Basque/northern Spain coastal-tourism basis.
